title: The Mammal Ephemeris
subtitle: Every mammal has a day. Its clade sets the month; its own name sets the hour, minute, and date. Search a species below to find its moment on the wheel.
wheelCaptionDefault: The alphabet ring marks days A–Z around each month; the bars beyond it show how many species share each day, relative to that month's busiest one. Choose a mammal, or click the ring itself, to see who's celebrating.
